title: The three sounds everyone stole

params.note: Synthesized recreation (SQUELCH's 808 worklet). The beat is an original electro-style pattern, not taken from any record. The kick is a sine with a fast pitch drop, the snare a tuned body plus filtered noise, the clap a burst of noise gated three times then a tail.

caption: A synthesized copy of how the TR-808 makes its sounds. The 808's kick has tone and decay controls but no tuning. Turn its decay all the way up and it stops sounding like a drum hit and rings on like a bass note. That long decay turned what people heard as the machine's weakness into its value, and it is behind a lot of hip-hop's low end.
